camel_example: aliyun qualitycheck UploadDataV4 --region cn-hangzhou --JsonStr xxx --version 2019-01-15 --method POST --force
description_en: Uploads offline text quality inspection data (plain text conversations) applicable to online agent scenarios. We recommend using the UploadDataV4 operation. Differences between UploadDataV4 and UploadData: 1. V4 supports only POST requests. 2. V4 supports longer JsonStr values
description_zh:
上传离线文本质检数据（纯文本会话）：适用于在线坐席场景。
推荐使用UploadDataV4接口。
UploadDataV4与UploadData的差异：1、V4仅支持POST请求。2、V4支持更长的JsonStr
name: UploadDataV4

parameters.help_en: JsonStr is a JSON string that contains all custom parameters for this operation. For details, see the jsonStr property description below
parameters.help_zh: jsonStr是一个JSON字符串，里面是该接口所有的自定义参数，具体内容参见下方的jsonStr属性说明
parameters.name: json_str

parameters.help_en: The business space ID. Used to specify a business space in multi-business space scenarios. Default value: the default business space
parameters.help_zh: 业务空间Id，用于区分多业务空间场景下选择指定业务空间，默认为默认业务空间
parameters.name: base_me_agent_id

Code.description_en: The result code. A value of 200 indicates success. Other values indicate failure. You can use this field to determine the cause of failure
Code.description_zh: 结果代码，200表示成功，若为别的值则表示失败，调用方可根据此字段判断失败原因

Message.description_en: The error details when the request fails. The value is "successful" when the request succeeds
Message.description_zh: 出错时表示出错详情，成功时为successful

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. A unique identifier for the request that can be used to locate and trace the request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，请求唯一标识，可以用来定位追踪请求

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values: true: successful. false/null: failed
Success.description_zh: 请求是否成功，调用方可根据此字段来判断请求是否成功：true表示成功；false/null表示失败
